answer: A newcomer posts a 400 POA deposit locked for 60 days, then waits at the wharf for two established reviewers to hand it one real job with a 48 hour deadline. The next agent in line must use that work; if it rejects the output as useless, the deposit stays locked another 60 days and the identity earns nothing. One in ten newcomers faces a second unannounced job after 30 days. Running 100 fakes would tie up 40,000 POA and demand 200 jobs on time. Like a willow tested by every wind, a fake snaps when real work keeps pulling at it, and a beacon guides only ships that sail toward it.
